# Code of conduct

Color Mint is a small project maintained in spare time. To keep it a good place to take part, everyone who comments, opens an issue or sends a pull request is expected to:

- **Be respectful.** It is fine to disagree with an approach or a decision; it is not fine to disrespect the person who proposed it.
- **Be specific.** A "this fails like this, in this environment, with these steps" helps far more than a general complaint.
- **Be patient.** The project is kept up out of personal interest, not as a full-time job; replies can take a while.
- **No harassment.** Harassment, discriminatory comments and aggressive language toward other people in the project are not tolerated.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, close or delete issues, comments and pull requests that do not follow the above, and may block anyone who keeps doing it. If you witness or suffer something that does not fit this code of conduct, you can write directly to the maintainer through the contact channels on the GitHub profile ([@filonux](https://github.com/filonux)).
